mathematical_findings: Correct concise aligned audit of the two specified inclusions. It gives the evaluable-path witness, the actual local bound, exact guarantee-domain threshold, actual path-chain/proxy bridge and shared-path joint argument; the wrapper conditions and stronger-scope boundary are retained. It does not separately reproduce the hLq function type, the common target domain or the residual formula; these are not credited as separately explained. The concrete local-to-global derivations and cited actual declarations are sufficient for this scoped audit, without requiring exhaustive reference reproduction. Native event54 supports43-module compilation and the three stated axiom checks.
Accurately accepts precisely the component and joint inclusions, with separate theorem and conjunction-wrapper distinction. No claim that compilation alone proves alignment.

Identifies evaluability as nonempty path-truncated sample, x in path domain and U, Lq+Lstar local bound, threshold condition and actual network representation. Correctly retains nonempty J, globally evaluable components and finite tolerances in the wrapper.

For the component branch it gives the full two-step inequality and the path-to-proxy substitution. For the joint branch it selects one path with J subset Ires(q), expands the joint domain, explains the nonempty-J intersection equivalence and applies the local theorem for every component on that same path.

Accurately states no supplementary proof is needed for these two original conclusions; the weaker underlying lemmas support the wrapper. Does not demand a stronger whole-U coverage theorem or misdiagnose an unrelated chapter statement.

evidence.quote: **附件的 Lean 实现准确、完整地证明了“路径保证域的全局拟合含义”。** 正文的单分量包含式和联合包含式各有独立定理，`path_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error_text` 给出二者的合取。两式右端都是 \(U\) 中满足**真实代理–目标误差**阈值的点集。[正文推论](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-max-20261119/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/source.md:242) · [Lean 总定理](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-max-20261119/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/formal_oet/vol_03/ch_14_empirical_network_fitting/path_guarantee_domains.lean:590)

1. **单分量形式。** Lean 用存在一条可达路径 `q` 表达属于路径并集。筛选条件 `j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q` 恰好表示 \(S_{q,j}=S_j\cap U_q\ne\varnothing\)。取出这条路径后，保证域成员条件给出 \(x\in U_q\subseteq U\)。路径局部上界与保证域的阈值条件依次给出
   \[
   d_j(c_q(x),\phi^\natural(x))
   \le D_{\mathbf L_q+\mathbf L^*,j}(x;S_{q,j})+\hat\varepsilon_{q,j}
   \le \tau_j .
   \]
   网络表示假设 `hrep` 给出 \(c_q(x)=\phi(x)\)，因此这个界确实适用于代理算子 \(\phi\)。[路径可评估性](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-max-20261119/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/formal_oet/vol_03/ch_14_empirical_network_fitting/path_sampling.lean:59) · [路径链与代理的等式](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-max-20261119/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/formal_oet/vol_03/ch_14_empirical_network_fitting/path_sampling.lean:220) · [单分量包含式](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-max-20261119/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/formal_oet/vol_03/ch_14_empirical_network_fitting/path_guarantee_domains.lean:520)

2. **联合形式。** 源码先取出**同一条**满足 \(J\subseteq I_{\rm res}(q)\) 的路径 \(q\)。联合保证域的成员条件展开为 \(x\in U_q\)，且每个 \(i\in J\) 的路径证书上界都不超过 \(\tau_i\)。对非空 \(J\)，这恰好等价于正文的 \(x\in\bigcap_{i\in J}U_{q,i}(\tau_i)\)。证明随后固定任意 \(i\in J\)，在这条路径上应用 `path_joint_guarantee_error_bound`，再用 \(c_q(x)=\phi(x)\) 改写，得到所要求的全部分量界。[联合保证域定义](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-max-20261119/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/formal_oet/vol_03/ch_12_residuals_and_substitution/guarantee_domains.lean:35) · [联合包含式](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-max-20261119/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/formal_oet/vol_03/ch_14_empirical_network_fitting/path_guarantee_domains.lean:553)
总定理显式保留了全局可评估性、\(J\) 非空和所选阈值有限等正文条件。证明直接调用前提更弱的两个定理，因此这些条件虽未参与最后一步推导，正文的两条包含式均无需补证。我用 Lean 4.29.1 编译了目标模块，并核对了上述三个定理的公理依赖，均只有 `propext`、`Classical.choice` 和 `Quot.sound`。
